items.zh: 这个能退吗？我昨天刚买的。
items.scene: 顾客拿着昨天买的耳机回店里退货

answers.en: Can I return this? I just bought it yesterday.
answers.note: 直接问能不能退，语气中性，最常见，适合已经在收银台前开口。

answers.en: Is this returnable? I only got it yesterday.
answers.note: 先确认退货政策再动作，returnable 偏书面，适合不确定店里规矩时。

answers.en: Could I get a refund on this? I bought it yesterday.
answers.note: 明确要退款而不是换货，could 比 can 客气，适合对方看起来不好说话。

items.zh: 就这服务，我给你们打一星不过分吧？
items.scene: 外卖迟到一小时，顾客在订单页评价

answers.en: I'm leaving a one-star review.
answers.note: 陈述即将做的事，像通知对方，带明显不满，适合评价页上直接写。

answers.en: You're getting a bad review for this.
answers.note: 更口语，当面说给对方听，情绪外露，适合对着商家客服讲。

answers.en: I'll have to leave a negative review.
answers.note: have to 显得不情愿，偏正式，听起来像给对方最后一次机会。

items.zh: 你们客服电话怎么一直打不通？
items.scene: 顾客连打三天售后热线都是忙音

answers.en: I've been calling your customer service line for three days and can't get through.
answers.note: 先讲自己打了多久，用事实施压，抱怨但没骂人。

answers.en: Why is your customer service number always busy?
answers.note: 直接质问，把问题归给对方，语气冲，适合已经火了。

answers.en: I can't seem to get anyone on your customer service line.
answers.note: can't seem to 弱化指责，听起来无奈，适合先礼后兵。

items.zh: 我都排了四十分钟了，能不能多开一个窗口？
items.scene: 银行只开一个窗口，队伍排到门口

answers.en: I've been in line for forty minutes — can you open another window?
answers.note: 先摆等待时间再提要求，中性偏直接，适合对柜员说。

answers.en: Any chance you could open a second window? I've been waiting forty minutes.
answers.note: any chance 让请求变软，客气，适合不想起冲突时。

answers.en: Forty minutes in line and there's still just one window open.
answers.note: 只陈述事实不提要求，让对方自己接话，不满藏在话里。

items.zh: 你们店员刚才那个态度什么意思？
items.scene: 顾客被店员翻白眼后找店长理论

answers.en: What's with the attitude?
answers.note: 最短最冲，口语质问，适合当场拦住人直接问。

answers.en: The way your employee just spoke to me was not okay.
answers.note: 把焦点放在行为上，克制但正式，适合找店长说。

answers.en: I'd like to talk to you about how your staff just treated me.
answers.note: 最客气，像约谈话，反而显得认真，适合不想吵但要走流程。

items.zh: 东西送过来全洒了，这个怎么赔？
items.scene: 外卖汤洒了一袋，顾客拍照发给商家

answers.en: It arrived completely spilled — how are you going to make this right?
answers.note: make this right 是美式客服常用语，要求补救，语气硬。

answers.en: Everything spilled in transit. What kind of compensation can I get?
answers.note: 偏正式，直接问赔偿，像在走流程，不带情绪。

answers.en: Half the order leaked out. Am I getting a refund for this?
answers.note: 只盯退款，语气不耐，适合已经不想听解释时。

items.zh: 你们送餐员把餐扔楼下就走，这事我该找谁投诉？
items.scene: 骑手把餐扔楼下就走，顾客打给商家

answers.en: I want to file a complaint about your delivery driver.
answers.note: file a complaint 正式，像要走正式渠道，适合大平台。

answers.en: I'm reporting your driver.
answers.note: 最短最硬，report 带官方味，压迫感强。

answers.en: I need to complain about the driver who delivered my order.
answers.note: 口语，need to 表明态度坚决，但没前两条正式。

items.zh: 这个还在保修期内，能免费修吗？
items.scene: 顾客拿用了一年半的电动牙刷到售后

answers.en: It's still under warranty — can you fix it for free?
answers.note: 直接确认保修再提要求，语气平常，适合柜台开口。

answers.en: Is this still covered? I've had it about a year and a half.
answers.note: 先问是否在保，covered 是保修的口语说法，谨慎试探。

answers.en: I'd like to get this repaired under warranty.
answers.note: 正式，把保修当权利主张，适合对方开始推脱时。

items.zh: 我上个月买的，能补开发票吗？
items.scene: 顾客拿收据回店里开发票报销

answers.en: Can I get an invoice for this? I bought it last month.
answers.note: invoice 指报销用的正式发票，直接问，适合公司报销。

answers.en: I need a receipt for something I bought last month.
answers.note: receipt 偏收银小票，语气直接，适合小店或个体户。

answers.en: Is it possible to get an invoice for a purchase from last month?
answers.note: 最客气，句式绕，适合对方是陌生店员或大公司前台。

items.zh: 转了五分钟还是机器人，能帮我转人工吗？
items.scene: 顾客被电话机器人菜单绕了五分钟

answers.en: Can I talk to a real person?
answers.note: 最常见，real person 直白，带点不耐烦。

answers.en: I'd like to speak with a representative, please.
answers.note: 客服标准说法，正式礼貌，适合还在克制时。

answers.en: Get me a human.
answers.note: 很冲，几乎是命令，适合已经被绕烦、不想再客气。

items.zh: 退款什么时候能到账？
items.scene: 退货三天了，顾客查银行卡还没到账

answers.en: When will the refund show up?
answers.note: show up 指钱出现在账户里，口语，中性。

answers.en: How long does the refund take to process?
answers.note: 问处理时长，偏正式，像在确认流程而不是催。

answers.en: The refund still hasn't hit my account — when should I expect it?
answers.note: hit my account 口语，先说没到账再问，催得更紧。

items.zh: 为什么只退了一半的钱？
items.scene: 顾客发现退款比付款少了一半

answers.en: Why did I only get half the refund?
answers.note: 直接问原因，句子短促，语气偏冲，适合已经压不住火时。

answers.en: It looks like I only got half of what I paid back.
answers.note: 先陈述自己看到的结果，语气缓和，给对方留出解释空间。

answers.en: Could you check why the refund came to less than what I paid?
answers.note: 请对方去核查，最客气的一版，适合还不想撕破脸的时候。

items.zh: 你们是说删了差评才给我退款？
items.scene: 商家打电话要求先删评价再退款

answers.en: So you're saying I have to delete my review before I get a refund?
answers.note: 复述对方条件，so 带难以置信，逼对方再确认一次。

answers.en: Are you seriously making the refund conditional on taking down my review?
answers.note: seriously 表震惊，用词正式，适合通话录音留证据。

answers.en: That sounds like you're tying my refund to deleting the review.
answers.note: sounds like 留余地，实为指控，适合冷静施压。

items.zh: 你们部门之间推来推去，到底谁负责？
items.scene: 顾客被转接四次还没人处理

answers.en: I've been passed around four times — who's actually handling this?
answers.note: passed around 指被踢皮球，直接追问，火气明显。

answers.en: Every department keeps sending me to someone else. Can someone take ownership of this?
answers.note: take ownership 是职场正式说法，克制但施压。

answers.en: Is anyone actually responsible for this, or am I just going to keep getting transferred?
answers.note: 反问带讽刺，情绪外露，适合已经忍无可忍。

items.zh: 你们打算怎么处理？
items.scene: 快递丢件，客服只说会反馈就没下文

answers.en: So what are you going to do about it?
answers.note: 短促追问，开头的 so 带不耐烦，逼对方当场给方案。

answers.en: What's the next step here?
answers.note: 只问流程，冷静中性，适合不想吵架但要把事推进。

answers.en: I'd like to know what compensation you're offering.
answers.note: 偏正式，直接把赔偿说出来，像书面投诉的口吻。

items.zh: 最近的保修点在哪？
items.scene: 顾客手机坏了，问客服去哪修

answers.en: Where's the nearest authorized repair center?
answers.note: authorized 指官方授权，问得具体，适合查官方网点。

answers.en: Is there a service center near me?
answers.note: 口语，泛泛问附近有没有网点，不限定是不是官方。

answers.en: Can you tell me where I can get this repaired nearby?
answers.note: 请求句式，三条里最客气，适合还没生气、只想问清地址。

items.zh: 让我听二十分钟音乐，你们客服就这效率？
items.scene: 客服热线等了二十分钟终于接通

answers.en: I've been on hold for twenty minutes.
answers.note: on hold 指等待接通，平铺直叙，抱怨但克制，适合刚接通时。

answers.en: Twenty minutes of hold music is ridiculous.
answers.note: 直接给评价，情绪明显，带讽刺，适合已经憋了一肚子气。

answers.en: Do you know how long I've been waiting on this line?
answers.note: 反问句，把火撒给刚接通的客服，压迫感最强，也最伤和气。

items.zh: 发票抬头开错了，能重开吗？
items.scene: 顾客发现公司名写错，找商家重开

answers.en: The invoice has the wrong company name — can you reissue it?
answers.note: reissue 指重开，正式，一次说清问题加要求。

answers.en: My company name is misspelled on the invoice. Can I get a new one?
answers.note: 口语，只描述错误，语气平常，适合柜台沟通。

answers.en: Would it be possible to have the invoice corrected?
answers.note: 最客气，被动句，适合对不熟的商家或财务。

items.zh: 你们店员说不归他管，我能见你们经理吗？
items.scene: 店员说不归他管，顾客要求见负责人

answers.en: I want to see your manager.
answers.note: 最直接，近乎命令，适合话已经说僵、不想再绕的时候。

answers.en: Could I speak with a manager, please?
answers.note: 礼貌请求，please 起缓冲作用，但意图和前一条一样明确。

answers.en: Is there someone above you I can talk to?
answers.note: 绕开眼前这个人，暗示不信任他，比前两条委婉。

items.zh: 箱子压扁了，里面的东西也碎了，怎么办？
items.scene: 顾客当着快递员的面拆开压扁的箱子

answers.en: The box was crushed and everything inside is broken.
answers.note: 陈述损坏情况，像在报损，冷静克制，适合先拍照留证据。

answers.en: Look at this — it's completely smashed.
answers.note: 边指边给对方看，情绪直接，适合当面拆箱时。

answers.en: The package arrived damaged. How do I file a claim?
answers.note: 偏正式，直接问理赔流程，适合在快递公司柜台填单时。

items.zh: 能不能退回到我原来的付款方式？
items.scene: 客服提出退成店铺余额，顾客不同意

answers.en: Can you put it back on my card?
answers.note: put it back on 是口语说法，直接要求原路退回，不绕弯。

answers.en: I'd prefer the refund to go back to my original payment method.
answers.note: prefer 表偏好，说法正式，给双方都留有余地。

answers.en: I don't want store credit — I want it refunded to my card.
answers.note: 先拒绝再要求，最硬，适合对方一直推余额时。

items.zh: 同一台笔记本修了三次还没好，你说怎么办？
items.scene: 同一台笔记本第三次送修，顾客在柜台

answers.en: This is the third time I've brought it in.
answers.note: 只摆次数，不说要求，让对方自己接，克制但有力。

answers.en: Three repairs and it still doesn't work — I want a replacement.
answers.note: 把维修直接升级成换新，强硬，适合当场摊牌。

answers.en: At this point I'd like to discuss a replacement rather than another repair.
answers.note: 正式，用 discuss 包装要求，适合要求找主管谈。

items.zh: 你上次说二十四小时回复，现在都第三天了？
items.scene: 客服承诺回电却没打，顾客再打过去

answers.en: You said I'd hear back within twenty-four hours.
answers.note: 直接复述承诺，带质问，适合找同一个人对质。

answers.en: I was told someone would call me back yesterday.
answers.note: 被动，只讲被承诺过，不点名指责，留台阶。

answers.en: Nobody got back to me. What happened?
answers.note: 口语，先陈述再问，语气最缓，适合先探对方态度。

items.zh: 我给了差评，一周了怎么没人联系我？
items.scene: 顾客给差评一周，商家一直没联系

answers.en: I left a bad review a week ago and nobody's reached out.
answers.note: 陈述事实，抱怨没人处理，克制但意思明确，适合打字留言。

answers.en: Does anyone actually read these reviews?
answers.note: 反问带讽刺，不直接提要求，让对方自己领会言外之意。

answers.en: I posted a negative review hoping someone would contact me.
answers.note: 说明自己当初的用意，语气软，像主动给对方一个台阶。

items.zh: 行李丢了两天，你们就赔这么点？
items.scene: 航空公司行李延误两天，顾客在柜台

answers.en: My bag was missing for two days — is this all I get?
answers.note: is this all 表难以置信，情绪明显，适合在柜台当场发问。

answers.en: That compensation doesn't come close to covering what I lost.
answers.note: 偏正式，直接反驳赔偿金额，像在跟对方谈判。

answers.en: Two days without my luggage and that's the offer? Come on.
answers.note: come on 表不满又不算骂人，情绪外露，适合柜台当场发作。
